moments.author: Jalen Duren
moments.quote: BREAKING: Restricted free agent center Jalen Duren has agreed to accept the five‑year, $200M contract from the Detroit Pistons
moments.why: A massive guaranteed deal ending a high‑stakes standoff — dominant conversation among NBA fans, men 25–45.

moments.author: Sam Amick & Hunter Patterson
moments.quote: Detroit’s five‑year, $200M offer included a weight clause requiring Duren to check his weight monthly — weight clause removed from offer
moments.why: The weight clause detail added drama to the deal and sparked explosive fan debate.
